title: Don Alexis to the Reader
author: Alexis of Piemont
full_title: The Secretes of the Reuerende Maister Alexis of Piemount
summary: The preface in its first English printing. The aged Alexis explains why he is publishing remedies he once guarded jealously: a poor artisan in Milan died of the stone after Alexis refused to give his cure to the surgeon, and in remorse he resolves to give all his tested secrets to the world.
